items.mainDefect: The computed schema keys are literal property names rather than wildcards, causing token fields to be stripped.

secondary.defect: Missing refresh tokens are replaced with the literal string "refresh_token", overwriting valid stored tokens.

items.mainDefect: Every service construction unconditionally refreshes tokens and writes to the database.

secondary.defect: Checking statusText against "OK" rejects successful responses with an empty statusText.
The jsforce Connection uses the old access token instead of the refreshed token.
In sync mode, the stored refresh token is overwritten with the parser's placeholder.

items.mainDefect: The webhook secret comparison is not constant-time and can leak timing information.

secondary.defect: Malformed request bodies cause unhandled exceptions and 500 responses instead of 400 responses.
Decryption or decrypted JSON parsing failures produce unhandled 500 responses instead of 400 responses.

items.mainDefect: The refresh call passes the credential ID instead of the owning user's ID, requesting tokens for the wrong user.

secondary.defect: Passing a non-null credential ID also bypasses the check that should exclude team credentials from sync.

items.mainDefect: Token validation failures now throw and abort calendar operations instead of preserving existing credentials.

secondary.defect: The subsequent success-and-data guard is now dead code.
The diagnostic log for token validation failures was removed.

items.mainDefect: The computed schema keys collapse to a literal property name, causing legitimate token fields to be stripped.

secondary.defect: The parser replaces the refresh token with the literal placeholder "refresh_token".

items.mainDefect: The refresh call passes the credential ID instead of the user ID, requesting tokens for the wrong user.

secondary.defect: The non-null credential ID incorrectly enables sync for team credentials that should skip it.
